process_execution.fixed_child: candidate-local r8_subject_task_driver.py with the same four binding arguments
process_execution.poll_rule: The process controller calls communicate with a bounded timeout repeatedly, treating every timeout as a live-child poll, until the child has actually exited.
process_execution.stdout_rule: No stdout is emitted by the process controller before the child exits zero and its full stdout is one exact canonical completed receipt-v4 plus one terminal LF.
process_execution.failure_rule: Empty, LF-only, partial, malformed, noncanonical, controller-invalid, nonzero-exit, or binding-mismatched child output emits no terminal envelope on stdout and exits nonzero.

outer_unified_exec_gate.live_result_definition: The initial unified exec result supplies a live session identifier without an exit_code.
outer_unified_exec_gate.mandatory_action: Poll that exact live session with write_stdin until a result carries an actual exit_code.
outer_unified_exec_gate.admission: Admit only exit_code=0 after all stdout chunks have been fully captured and reconstruct exactly one canonical terminal envelope.
outer_unified_exec_gate.no_live_session: A synchronous initial result is admissible only when it already carries exit_code=0 and complete canonical terminal-envelope stdout.
outer_unified_exec_gate.persistence_method: external create-only apply_patch after outer terminal admission

live_outer_session_rule: When outer_exec_live_session_observed=true, outer_exec_session_id must be nonempty and outer_exec_poll_count must be at least one; a live session without terminal observation always rejects.
receipt_binding_rule: The observation receipt path, SHA-256, byte count, candidate, run, slot, cell, execution root, completed status, first-attempt flags, and exact canonical receipt-v4 storage must all match the persisted receipt.
delayed_process_proofs: delayed complete receipt is withheld until at least one live poll and then admitted
delayed valid receipt followed by nonzero exit rejects
nonclaims: No provider or subject call is made by self-test or holdouts.
Static process proofs are not empirical model qualification.
A persisted observation is trusted external-controller evidence; the verifier cannot retrospectively authenticate the unified-exec service transcript.
